  "reasons": [
    "When bad debts occur and a provision for doubtful debts already exists that exceeds the bad debts, bad debts are first written off against debtors and then closed by debiting Provision for Doubtful Debts Account.",
    "Because the existing provision of ₹20,000 is greater than the bad debts of ₹15,000, Revaluation Account is not debited for this write-off."
  ],

      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []

      "condition": "Existing provision for doubtful debts absorbs bad debts before any impact on Revaluation Account.",
